findings.title: path used but not imported in tracker.mjs
findings.problem: GitLabTracker.upload falls back to path.basename when glab's answer has no markdown field, but node:path is never imported, so that branch throws a ReferenceError that is reported as 'upload failed'.
findings.rootCause: The fallback branch is never exercised (the stub always returns markdown, real GitLab always does too) and the import was missed.
findings.fix: Add import path from 'node:path', or drop the markdown fallback since callers only use url.

findings.title: Catch assumes an Error
findings.problem: A non-Error thrown from tracker.upload yields 'upload failed: undefined'; a thrown null/undefined raises a TypeError inside the catch and aborts the post, against the never-abort-for-a-picture rule.
findings.fix: Use error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error).

findings.title: Stale header comment and out-of-order mode docs
findings.problem: File header still says screenshots are embedded from the pushed branch URL on GitHub and GitLab; the rewriteLinks doc lists the upload mode after the return line.
findings.rootCause: Documentation not updated with the behavior change.
findings.fix: Describe blob links on GitHub and uploads on GitLab, and reorder the mode list.

findings.title: upload return shape differs from spec and is partly unused
findings.problem: Spec says upload returns the markdown; code returns {url, markdown, fullPath} and only url is used.
findings.rootCause: Implementation diverged from spec during coding.
findings.fix: Trim the unused fields or update the spec.

findings.title: Test gaps around upload
findings.problem: The test named for github and odoo covers only GitHub; there is no test for the failed-upload branch with base null, for a file linked twice, for a non-Error throw, or for the markdown-missing fallback.
findings.rootCause: Tests cover the happy path and one fallback; the other branches added in rewriteLinks and upload are unexercised.
findings.fix: Add the missing cases, including OdooTracker.upload rejecting with no-upload.

tdd.notes: Tests and code share one commit so test-first cannot be shown from history, but the changed and added tests assert output behavior and would fail on main (blob/?raw=true, /uploads/ embeds, failed-upload fallback, glab api argv). Gaps: OdooTracker.upload, base-null failed upload, duplicate link, non-Error throw, markdown fallback (which hides the missing path import). No real-glab or live-forge test.

strengths: GitHub path matches spec: linkBase blob URL, ?raw=true only on images; tracker.upload is never reached for GitHub
Upload failure falls back to the raw link with a note and never aborts the post
Security invariants kept: insideArtifacts and the real-path check precede every read and upload
execFile with an argv element makes spaces in paths safe; path.sep use is correct on Windows
Uploads are deduplicated per decoded name; part limits still hold
SKILL.md sentence and release-notes entry match the code; old-URL tests updated, not weakened
